title: Secret Powers
body:
Rushdie, Mao tse Tung ... all these secret powers entice people to come to them. They say, "Come, come!
Come under my feet and kneel down!"
So you do not believe in secret powers? Do you not believe in the secret police, in the intelligence service?
Mussolini also had a secret police... So there must be secret powers. There are secret powers in this electrical
wire. Or can you see them? Sometimes it will produce light, sometimes fire, sometimes ice, sometimes sound.
Sometimes it will be an engine, sometimes a computer, sometimes radar, sometimes a cleaner, sometimes a
washer. Sometimes it will produce cold weather, sometimes it is a heater... All of this is produced with one
thing: electricity. So what is that? It is like a tap which you can open or close. What power is it?
Italy - 01.11.1994
